notes: Real Chromium. Controls use the real opening platform; word input uses seeded vocabulary. Combat/bow/skills use response-only scene fixtures, production input and mechanics.
Full route uses real keyboard input including W + K, with automatic answers only; no position, health or win-state mutations.
Compatibility arrows and S + W remain, while HUD/guide teach the primary WASD controls.
No remote push. Automated correctness does not certify subjective comfort or every keyboard/device.

Initial legacy test failures came from fixed wall-clock waits, counting the next grounded combo as part of the previous airborne interval, and starting a blade before the bow-release sample arrived. Final tests use state snapshots and explicit action transitions; cooldown precision and two-air-hit assertions remain intact.
